trump silent after fleeing suspected iranian assassination plot in a catering truck
trump was moved off air force one in a catering truck to avoid a suspected iranian assassination plot, and has since said nothing publicly about the episode. according to the washington post, he took three aides with him — dan scavino, natalie harp and walt nauta — while deputy chief of staff stephen miller, secretary of state marco rubio and other cabinet officials were not chosen; pete hegseth later joined. senior staff, secret service, military personnel and the press pool remained aboard the original aircraft, and journalists on the plane said they were placed at risk without being told.

topics.text:
federal judge blocks trump executive order limiting mail-in voting
judge talwani in the district of massachusetts issued an order blocking section 3 of an executive order that would have conditioned usps delivery of mail-in ballots on states handing over their voter lists. an earlier block was already in place; the injunction has now been expanded. with the midterm elections less than 90 days away, the ruling is expected to stand through november regardless of any appeal to the supreme court.

topics.headline: ICE agent filmed pointing gun at US citizen during traffic stop
topics.snippet: An ICE agent pulled a woman over and pointed a firearm at her during the stop. She said she is a U.S. citizen and the agent responded that he could arrest her anyway, alleging she had threatened to ru…
topics.text:
ice agent filmed pointing gun at us citizen during traffic stop
an ice agent pulled a woman over and pointed a firearm at her during the stop. she said she is a u.s. citizen and the agent responded that he could arrest her anyway, alleging she had threatened to run him over; her dash camera recorded the opposite. the agents then left the scene.

topics.headline: ICE to spend up to $20 million on shock gloves for agents
topics.snippet: The Associated Press confirmed that ICE plans to spend up to $20 million on gloves that can deliver an electric shock to people agents attempt to detain. The devices, made by Compliant Technologies, a…
topics.text:
ice to spend up to $20 million on shock gloves for agents
the associated press confirmed that ice plans to spend up to $20 million on gloves that can deliver an electric shock to people agents attempt to detain. the devices, made by compliant technologies, are described as "conductive distraction and de-escalation devices" and function as normal patrol gloves until an electrical mode is switched on. money previously allocated for body cameras for ice agents has not yet resulted in every agent being equipped with one.

topics.headline: Sailors on USS Abraham Lincoln attempt to jump overboard amid extended deployment
topics.snippet: Several service members aboard the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln have reportedly attempted to jump overboard during a repeatedly extended Middle East deployment, with one account putting the nu…
topics.text:
sailors on uss abraham lincoln attempt to jump overboard amid extended deployment
several service members aboard the aircraft carrier uss abraham lincoln have reportedly attempted to jump overboard during a repeatedly extended middle east deployment, with one account putting the number at six. reported conditions include moldy showers, food rationing and shortages of soap, shampoo and deodorant. one sailor's wife told the military times her husband is on a medical hold; the navy has not released figures on attempts to go overboard or self-harm during the deployment.

topics.headline: Trump has personally profited more than $2.2 billion since taking office
topics.snippet: Trump has personally profited more than $2.2 billion since taking office, alongside an $800 million fundraising operation run from the Oval Office. He sought to direct $1.8 billion in taxpayer money t…
topics.text:
trump has personally profited more than $2.2 billion since taking office
trump has personally profited more than $2.2 billion since taking office, alongside an $800 million fundraising operation run from the oval office. he sought to direct $1.8 billion in taxpayer money to allies and has been selling access to his truth social posts to wall street firms and large corporations. pardons would not shield the proceeds from civil asset forfeiture, and congressional oversight investigations are expected.

topics.headline: Mike Lindell loses Minnesota governor primary by double digits and disputes result
topics.snippet: Mike Lindell, who left the MyPillow company he founded to run for governor of Minnesota with Trump's endorsement, lost the Republican primary by more than 10 points. He has refused to accept the resul…
topics.text:
mike lindell loses minnesota governor primary by double digits and disputes result
mike lindell, who left the mypillow company he founded to run for governor of minnesota with trump's endorsement, lost the republican primary by more than 10 points. he has refused to accept the result, alleging election interference and that the primary was rigged. the defeat is also a setback for trump, whose endorsed candidate lost by double digits.

topics.headline: David Crowley narrowly wins Wisconsin governor primary
topics.snippet: David Crowley advanced to the general election for governor of Wisconsin after edging out democratic socialist candidate Francesca Hahn, 39.8% to 39.3%.
topics.text:
david crowley narrowly wins wisconsin governor primary
david crowley advanced to the general election for governor of wisconsin after edging out democratic socialist candidate francesca hahn, 39.8% to 39.3%.

topics.headline: Bill would bar AI data centers from public lands after Nevada fast-track
topics.snippet: H.R. 9939, the No A.I. Data Centers on Public Lands Act, was introduced two weeks ago in response to a data center approved on federal land in Nevada. After Boulder City voted the project down, the de…
topics.text:
bill would bar ai data centers from public lands after nevada fast-track
h.r. 9939, the no a.i. data centers on public lands act, was introduced two weeks ago in response to a data center approved on federal land in nevada. after boulder city voted the project down, the developer moved 10 miles onto federal land where local officials and voters had no say, and the project was classified as essentially the same use as a solar farm to reuse existing paperwork. it was approved without a new environmental review despite sitting in the drought-stricken colorado river basin, 10 miles from lake mead and on protected desert tortoise habitat; another nevada developer has since asked the blm to swap an approved solar project for a data center.

topics.headline: Retailers build out surveillance pricing as New York forces disclosure
topics.snippet: Retailers are developing systems that set individual prices from personal data, including a Walmart patent for a shopping cart with sensors that track cart speed and body temperature and feed the data…
topics.text:
retailers build out surveillance pricing as new york forces disclosure
retailers are developing systems that set individual prices from personal data, including a walmart patent for a shopping cart with sensors that track cart speed and body temperature and feed the data to a server for analysis. companies are acquiring ai pricing firms and building camera and cooler-screen systems that feed "consumer intelligence" and agitation scores used to estimate what a shopper will pay. a new new york law requires retailers to disclose when an algorithm uses personal data to set prices — one example showed a carton of eggs at $1.99 in one neighborhood and $2.29 in another on the same website — and new york is currently the only state requiring that disclosure.

topics.headline: Ukraine paused some tanker strikes at US request, FT reports
topics.snippet: Ukraine paused some strikes on tankers following a request from the United States, according to a Financial Times report. Reuters was unable to verify the account.
topics.text:
ukraine paused some tanker strikes at us request, ft reports
ukraine paused some strikes on tankers following a request from the united states, according to a financial times report. reuters was unable to verify the account.

topics.headline: Russia releases former US Marine Robert Gilman
topics.snippet: Russia has released former U.S. Marine Robert Gilman on humanitarian grounds, U.S. officials said.
topics.text:
russia releases former us marine robert gilman
russia has released former u.s. marine robert gilman on humanitarian grounds, u.s. officials said.

topics.headline: Nearly 30,000 pounds of imported raw beef recalled over skipped inspections
topics.snippet: Nearly 30,000 pounds of raw beef imported from South America has been recalled in at least two states because it entered the United States without passing required inspections. The boneless beef produ…
topics.text:
nearly 30,000 pounds of imported raw beef recalled over skipped inspections
nearly 30,000 pounds of raw beef imported from south america has been recalled in at least two states because it entered the united states without passing required inspections. the boneless beef products, from corte argentino usa llc, were produced between may 15 and may 20, 2026, with use-or-freeze-by dates between september 15 and september 20, 2026, and include top sirloin butt, eye round, top side cap off, flat and knuckle cuts. it is classified as a class i recall, meaning there is a reasonable probability that using the products will cause serious adverse health consequences or death.

topics.headline: Pastrami and corned beef recalled over possible listeria contamination
topics.snippet: More than 3,000 pounds of pastrami and corned beef have been recalled over possible listeria contamination. The recall covers 10-pound boxes of Minimar premium beef pastrami with case code 19410, and…
topics.text:
pastrami and corned beef recalled over possible listeria contamination
more than 3,000 pounds of pastrami and corned beef have been recalled over possible listeria contamination. the recall covers 10-pound boxes of minimar premium beef pastrami with case code 19410, and 20-to-30-pound boxes of baia's best cooked corned beef brisket and kirsch delicatessen-style cooked corned beef brisket, all produced by city foods. the products were shipped to illinois, iowa and michigan but distributed nationwide, following recent recalls of raw beef, jalapenos and shredded lettuce.

topics.headline: Trump used Air Force One as decoy over Iranian assassination threat, reports say
topics.snippet: According to reporting from the Washington Post, Trump secretly switched aircraft while leaving the NATO summit in Turkey earlier this year after credible intelligence indicated Iran was preparing an…
topics.text:
trump used air force one as decoy over iranian assassination threat, reports say
according to reporting from the washington post, trump secretly switched aircraft while leaving the nato summit in turkey earlier this year after credible intelligence indicated iran was preparing an assassination attempt targeting air force one. trump boarded the older air force one in view of the press, was moved off the plane in a catering cart onto a separate military aircraft, and met a different jet in england, while journalists and white house staff flew on the decoy believing he was aboard. separately, air defense systems were positioned near trump while he golfed at a tournament in new jersey. critics said the episode, including leaving roughly 50 to 65 crew, staff and press on the decoy flight, undercuts the administration's claims to have decimated iran's military.

topics.headline: Trump declines to rule out declaring a national emergency over November elections
topics.snippet: In an interview on Real America's Voice conducted overnight, Trump was asked whether he would seize control of America's elections or declare a national emergency ahead of November and answered that "…
topics.text:
trump declines to rule out declaring a national emergency over november elections
in an interview on real america's voice conducted overnight, trump was asked whether he would seize control of america's elections or declare a national emergency ahead of november and answered that "crazier things have happened." he has reportedly been advised by figures in his orbit to federalize elections and take over ballot counting. the remarks left open the possibility of federal intervention in the midterm vote.

topics.headline: Iran rules out talks with Trump administration until 2029
topics.snippet: Iran said there will be no future negotiations with the Trump administration and that it intends to wait for the next administration taking office in January 2029 to reach any deal. Tehran also said t…
topics.text:
iran rules out talks with trump administration until 2029
iran said there will be no future negotiations with the trump administration and that it intends to wait for the next administration taking office in january 2029 to reach any deal. tehran also said the strait of hormuz will remain closed until 2029 unless washington accepts its demands, which include compensation of $300 billion, release of up to $100 billion in frozen assets, lifting of all sanctions, withdrawal of u.s. troops from the region, and transit fees on the strait. trump in turn demanded compensation from iran after tehran sought payments from the united states. analysts warned the standoff leaves gas prices elevated into next year.

topics.headline: Iranian intelligence warns of U.S.-Israeli military buildup in Gulf states
topics.snippet: Iran's intelligence community says satellite imagery shows an ongoing buildup of U.S. and Israeli military forces in Gulf nations, and warned of a possible joint air campaign or ground invasion. The w…
topics.text:
iranian intelligence warns of u.s.-israeli military buildup in gulf states
iran's intelligence community says satellite imagery shows an ongoing buildup of u.s. and israeli military forces in gulf nations, and warned of a possible joint air campaign or ground invasion. the warning does not confirm that strikes are imminent, and a buildup alone does not indicate an attack has been ordered. no confirmation from washington or jerusalem was reported.

topics.headline: Justice Department expands executive privilege to cover outside advisers
topics.snippet: The Justice Department's Office of Legal Counsel has issued a legal opinion extending executive privilege to Trump's communications with private advisers outside the White House, according to Punchbow…
topics.text:
justice department expands executive privilege to cover outside advisers
the justice department's office of legal counsel has issued a legal opinion extending executive privilege to trump's communications with private advisers outside the white house, according to punchbowl news. the opinion holds that such communications are privileged so long as they relate to official presidential decision-making, a broader reading than the traditional scope covering white house staff. the move comes as democrats prepare for possible investigations of the president and his outside advisers if they take the house.

topics.headline: New York Times reports $100 million foreign purchase funneled to Trump-controlled company
topics.snippet: The New York Times reported that a foreign businessman identified as Mr. Zhao, who had no prior ties to the president and had faced money laundering allegations, bought $100 million worth of coins in…
topics.text:
new york times reports $100 million foreign purchase funneled to trump-controlled company
the new york times reported that a foreign businessman identified as mr. zhao, who had no prior ties to the president and had faced money laundering allegations, bought $100 million worth of coins in world liberty financial, the trump family crypto venture co-founded with middle east envoy steve witkoff and his son. under the company's policy, $75 million of that sum was then distributed to an entity owned and controlled by the president and his children. critics said comparable conduct by any other president would have triggered a congressional investigation.

topics.headline: Trump signs executive order overhauling childhood vaccine schedule
topics.snippet: Trump signed a sweeping executive order changing the U.S. vaccine schedule, spacing out shots and separating the MMR vaccine into multiple separate doses. Speaking in the Oval Office alongside RFK Jr.…
topics.text:
trump signs executive order overhauling childhood vaccine schedule
trump signed a sweeping executive order changing the u.s. vaccine schedule, spacing out shots and separating the mmr vaccine into multiple separate doses. speaking in the oval office alongside rfk jr., he said a soda-sized bottle's worth of vaccine was being poured into children and suggested a possible link between several vaccines and autism, claims that have been debunked. the american academy of pediatrics schedule remains the recommendation of practicing physicians.

topics.headline: Border wall construction begins inside Big Bend National Park
topics.snippet: Bulldozers have arrived at Big Bend National Park in Texas to begin construction of a section of border wall, funded with $1.7 billion in federal money. To proceed, the administration waived 29 statut…
topics.text:
border wall construction begins inside big bend national park
bulldozers have arrived at big bend national park in texas to begin construction of a section of border wall, funded with $1.7 billion in federal money. to proceed, the administration waived 29 statutes including the endangered species act, the clean water act, the clean air act, the national environmental policy act, and the native american graves protection and repatriation act. the project involves roads, barriers and surveillance systems, and conservationists warn it could worsen the park's water crisis and damage local ecology.

topics.headline: Trump Gaza plan ties Hamas disarmament to phased Israeli withdrawal
topics.snippet: Trump's plan for Gaza links the disarmament of Hamas to staged withdrawals of Israeli forces. Key disputes over the sequencing and terms remain unresolved.
topics.text:
trump gaza plan ties hamas disarmament to phased israeli withdrawal
trump's plan for gaza links the disarmament of hamas to staged withdrawals of israeli forces. key disputes over the sequencing and terms remain unresolved.

topics.headline: Syria sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia
topics.snippet: A Syrian court has sentenced former president Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia over crimes committed during the country's civil war. Assad is not in Syrian custody.
topics.text:
syria sentences bashar al-assad to death in absentia
a syrian court has sentenced former president bashar al-assad to death in absentia over crimes committed during the country's civil war. assad is not in syrian custody.

topics.headline: Russia bars its only registered anti-war party from September elections
topics.snippet: Russian authorities have barred Yabloko, the country's only registered anti-war party, from taking part in elections scheduled for September. The exclusion removes the sole ballot option explicitly op…
topics.text:
russia bars its only registered anti-war party from september elections
russian authorities have barred yabloko, the country's only registered anti-war party, from taking part in elections scheduled for september. the exclusion removes the sole ballot option explicitly opposed to the war in ukraine.

topics.headline: Russia says strikes hit Ukrainian logistics and steel sites
topics.snippet: Russia said its forces struck logistics facilities and steel production sites in Ukraine. Six people were reported killed in the attacks.
topics.text:
russia says strikes hit ukrainian logistics and steel sites
russia said its forces struck logistics facilities and steel production sites in ukraine. six people were reported killed in the attacks.

topics.snippet: Three people were killed in a suspected attack on a ship in the Red Sea. A separate vessel was struck off the coast of Pakistan.

three killed in suspected red sea ship attack as vessel hit off pakistan
three people were killed in a suspected attack on a ship in the red sea. a separate vessel was struck off the coast of pakistan.

topics.headline: Massachusetts removes gestational age limits on abortion
topics.snippet: Governor Maura Healey signed a bill making Massachusetts the tenth state to remove gestational age limits on abortion. Under the law, health care workers have greater discretion in determining whether…
topics.text:
massachusetts removes gestational age limits on abortion
governor maura healey signed a bill making massachusetts the tenth state to remove gestational age limits on abortion. under the law, health care workers have greater discretion in determining whether to perform an abortion later in pregnancy without facing legal penalties that existed under the state's previous restrictions. at the signing, healey said health care decisions should be made by women, families and their doctors rather than politicians, and cited cases of patients forced to travel out of state for care.

topics.headline: Nancy Mace post on Islam draws warnings over calls for violence
topics.snippet: Representative Nancy Mace posted on X on August 9 that one cannot pledge allegiance to the U.S. Constitution and Sharia law at the same time, and that Islam has no place in Western society. Responses…
topics.text:
nancy mace post on islam draws warnings over calls for violence
representative nancy mace posted on x on august 9 that one cannot pledge allegiance to the u.s. constitution and sharia law at the same time, and that islam has no place in western society. responses circulating on social platforms went further, using dehumanising language and urging people to attend a gathering in dearborn, michigan on august 18, with some framing it in terms of armed confrontation. representatives andy ogles and tommy tuberville were also named among figures amplifying the rhetoric.

topics.headline: Trump Media posts $238 million quarterly loss
topics.snippet: Trump Media and Technology Group, which owns Truth Social, reported a loss of $238 million through June, its worst quarter to date according to new financial records. The company is pivoting away from…
topics.text:
trump media posts $238 million quarterly loss
trump media and technology group, which owns truth social, reported a loss of $238 million through june, its worst quarter to date according to new financial records. the company is pivoting away from several ventures including crypto and is betting on a $100,000 subscription giving wall street early access to trump's truth social posts. the stock fell 8% following the announcement.

topics.headline: Iran appoints Mohsen Rezaei to lead top security council
topics.snippet: Iran named Mohsen Rezaei to head its highest security council. The appointment places him at the centre of Tehran's security decision-making.

iran appoints mohsen rezaei to lead top security council
iran named mohsen rezaei to head its highest security council. the appointment places him at the centre of tehran's security decision-making.

topics.headline: Lauren Boebert's son charged with sexual exploitation of a child
topics.snippet: Tyler Boebert, the 21-year-old son of Representative Lauren Boebert, has been charged in Colorado with three counts of sexual exploitation of a child and two counts of contributing to the delinquency…
topics.text:
lauren boebert's son charged with sexual exploitation of a child
tyler boebert, the 21-year-old son of representative lauren boebert, has been charged in colorado with three counts of sexual exploitation of a child and two counts of contributing to the delinquency of a child. according to nbc news, the charges stem from a video recording made when he was 18 involving a 17-year-old. authorities have not disclosed further details of the underlying allegations. he was taken into custody, posted a $10,000 bond and was released the same day.

topics.headline: Extreme heat in Italy threatens Parmigiano-Reggiano "cheese banks"
topics.snippet: A month of extreme heat in Italy is affecting both the production and storage of Parmigiano-Reggiano, including the vaults where hundreds of thousands of wheels are held. According to CBS, the wheels,…
topics.text:
extreme heat in italy threatens parmigiano-reggiano "cheese banks"
a month of extreme heat in italy is affecting both the production and storage of parmigiano-reggiano, including the vaults where hundreds of thousands of wheels are held. according to cbs, the wheels, each worth hundreds of euros, are used by local farmers as collateral for low-interest loans. rising temperatures could reduce output from the region.

topics.headline: Trump seen dozing during Oval Office executive order signing
topics.snippet: Trump appeared to doze off during an Oval Office event held for an executive order signing, with extended eye closures while others spoke. Similar episodes have been reported at recent Oval Office eve…
topics.text:
trump seen dozing during oval office executive order signing
trump appeared to doze off during an oval office event held for an executive order signing, with extended eye closures while others spoke. similar episodes have been reported at recent oval office events. trump, 80, posts on truth social overnight and holds signing sessions before the press during the day.

topics.headline: Trump reportedly willing to end Iran war without a nuclear deal
topics.snippet: According to the Wall Street Journal, President Trump has told senior officials he is prepared to end the US military campaign against Iran without any agreement on Iran's nuclear program, seeking onl…
topics.text:
trump reportedly willing to end iran war without a nuclear deal
according to the wall street journal, president trump has told senior officials he is prepared to end the us military campaign against iran without any agreement on iran's nuclear program, seeking only the reopening of the strait of hormuz. that marks a reversal from earlier positions demanding iran's unconditional surrender and a deal replacing the obama-era nuclear agreement. the strait of hormuz was open before the us strikes began and has since been closed by iran. reporting indicates trump privately described the war as lost, with a plan to return to roughly pre-war conditions; polling cited from ipsos shows a majority of us taxpayers oppose the campaign.

topics.headline: Iran says it will not negotiate until after Trump leaves office
topics.snippet: Iranian officials stated they will not negotiate with President Trump or his administration. They said talks would resume only in January 2029, when the current administration concludes.
topics.text:
iran says it will not negotiate until after trump leaves office
iranian officials stated they will not negotiate with president trump or his administration. they said talks would resume only in january 2029, when the current administration concludes.

topics.headline: Capital One closed more than 300 accounts linked to Trump over money laundering concerns
topics.snippet: Capital One shut down over 300 accounts tied to President Trump and his businesses, citing potential violations of the Anti-Money Laundering Act after identifying suspicious transactions. The accounts…
topics.text:
capital one closed more than 300 accounts linked to trump over money laundering concerns
capital one shut down over 300 accounts tied to president trump and his businesses, citing potential violations of the anti-money laundering act after identifying suspicious transactions. the accounts spanned the trump organization, eric trump, trump-branded wine and water products, and a golf course developer. the closures drew limited news coverage.

topics.headline: Republicans attack Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed over his marriage and faith
topics.snippet: President Trump posted a comparison of "two different versions of America" contrasting himself and Melania Trump with Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed and his wife. El-Sayed respond…
topics.text:
republicans attack senate candidate abdul el-sayed over his marriage and faith
president trump posted a comparison of "two different versions of america" contrasting himself and melania trump with michigan democratic senate candidate abdul el-sayed and his wife. el-sayed responded that the contrast was between people who make billions off the public and a couple who genuinely love each other and want to build a country where families can thrive. separately, senator tommy tuberville called el-sayed a "terrorist" and a "radical islamist" after michigan democrats nominated him. el-sayed is a detroit-born rhodes scholar with two doctorates who served as detroit's health director at 30 and taught epidemiology at columbia university.

topics.headline: Zelenskiy says up to 50,000 North Korean troops could deploy to Russia
topics.snippet: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said as many as 50,000 North Korean troops could be deployed to Russia. The statement points to a deepening military relationship between Moscow and Pyongyang.
topics.text:
zelenskiy says up to 50,000 north korean troops could deploy to russia
ukrainian president volodymyr zelenskiy said as many as 50,000 north korean troops could be deployed to russia. the statement points to a deepening military relationship between moscow and pyongyang.

topics.headline: Poland and Baltic states brace for possible Russian false-flag attack
topics.snippet: Poland and the Baltic states are tightening security amid concerns that Russia could stage a false-flag attack. Authorities in the region have raised their posture in response.

poland and baltic states brace for possible russian false-flag attack
poland and the baltic states are tightening security amid concerns that russia could stage a false-flag attack. authorities in the region have raised their posture in response.

topics.headline: Russia says Ukrainian drone attack killed 13 in Nizhnekamsk
topics.snippet: Russia said 13 people were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on Nizhnekamsk in Tatarstan. Ukraine said it had struck an oil refinery there.
topics.text:
russia says ukrainian drone attack killed 13 in nizhnekamsk
russia said 13 people were killed in a ukrainian drone attack on nizhnekamsk in tatarstan. ukraine said it had struck an oil refinery there.

topics.headline: Transportation Department recruits video gamers as air traffic controllers
topics.snippet: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the department has escalated a hiring campaign, launched in April, that recruits video gamers into air traffic controller positions. He said the effort reached…
topics.text:
transportation department recruits video gamers as air traffic controllers
transportation secretary sean duffy said the department has escalated a hiring campaign, launched in april, that recruits video gamers into air traffic controller positions. he said the effort reached 94% of its hiring goal in the fastest time on record, with more than 2,000 new controllers hired and candidates reaching the academy faster than any previous class. the advertising campaign specifically featured fortnite among the games used to target recruits.

topics.headline: Seven dead from flesh-eating bacteria in Gulf states as officials link cases to warming waters
topics.snippet: Seven people have died from flesh-eating bacteria in Gulf states in recent weeks, five in Louisiana and two in Florida. Louisiana has recorded nine cases, roughly four times its average, and state hea…
topics.text:
seven dead from flesh-eating bacteria in gulf states as officials link cases to warming waters
seven people have died from flesh-eating bacteria in gulf states in recent weeks, five in louisiana and two in florida. louisiana has recorded nine cases, roughly four times its average, and state health officials issued a warning urging precautions. officials said the bacterium becomes more prevalent as coastal waters warm, a trend tied to rising global temperatures.

topics.headline: Taylor Farms recalls salsa and guacamole nationwide amid salmonella outbreak
topics.snippet: Taylor Farms recalled salsa, guacamole and other prepared foods containing jalapenos sold at Walmart, Kroger, Whole Foods, Target, Trader Joe's and Hannaford across roughly 20 states. The CDC reports…
topics.text:
taylor farms recalls salsa and guacamole nationwide amid salmonella outbreak
taylor farms recalled salsa, guacamole and other prepared foods containing jalapenos sold at walmart, kroger, whole foods, target, trader joe's and hannaford across roughly 20 states. the cdc reports a salmonella outbreak that has sickened about 345 people and led to about 36 hospitalizations. chipotle and qdoba have pulled jalapenos from their menus. the action follows a separate taylor farms recall of shredded lettuce.

topics.headline: Islamophobic harassment campaigns spread online, including a planned pig release in Dearborn
topics.snippet: A wave of anti-Muslim content has circulated online, much of it centered on pork as a taunt directed at Muslims. A video showed a woman describing ordering pork after a woman in hijab sat near her, an…
topics.text:
islamophobic harassment campaigns spread online, including a planned pig release in dearborn
a wave of anti-muslim content has circulated online, much of it centered on pork as a taunt directed at muslims. a video showed a woman describing ordering pork after a woman in hijab sat near her, and a man in alabama publicised plans to release pigs in dearborn, michigan, a city with a muslim population of about 54%. police were called and the pig release was called off.

topics.headline: New bruising on Trump's forearm renews questions about his health
topics.snippet: A Reuters image shows multiple pronounced bruises running up President Trump's forearm, extending beyond the bruising previously visible on the back of his hands. Trump has also been diagnosed with ch…
topics.text:
new bruising on trump's forearm renews questions about his health
a reuters image shows multiple pronounced bruises running up president trump's forearm, extending beyond the bruising previously visible on the back of his hands. trump has also been diagnosed with chronic venous insufficiency, which has caused swollen ankles. the white house medical office has not provided full disclosure about the health of the president, who has turned 80.

topics.headline: CNN review finds Patriot Games competitors selected for political loyalty
topics.snippet: The Patriot Games, an athletic competition featuring one high school boy and one girl from each of the 50 states, opened in Ohio. A CNN review found competitors were chosen based on loyalty to the MAG…
topics.text:
cnn review finds patriot games competitors selected for political loyalty
the patriot games, an athletic competition featuring one high school boy and one girl from each of the 50 states, opened in ohio. a cnn review found competitors were chosen based on loyalty to the maga movement rather than athletic ability, with many aged 14 to 17, predominantly white, and drawn from homeschooling or christian private academies. several do not live in the states they represent, including a boy representing puerto rico who is from texas and a girl representing massachusetts who attends school in california. organisers told competitors of only one event, the 100-meter dash, in advance.

topics.headline: White House produces Game of Thrones-themed video with taxpayer funds
topics.snippet: The White House released a taxpayer-funded video using Game of Thrones imagery to depict President Trump on the Iron Throne, claiming he has restored the nation's capital. The video omits the Lincoln…
topics.text:
white house produces game of thrones-themed video with taxpayer funds
the white house released a taxpayer-funded video using game of thrones imagery to depict president trump on the iron throne, claiming he has restored the nation's capital. the video omits the lincoln memorial reflecting pool, which remains in disrepair.

topics.headline: Trump-linked oil firm plans Greenland drilling without government approval
topics.snippet: A Texas-based company called Greenland Energy is preparing to spend about $60 million drilling two exploratory wells in remote parts of Greenland, according to The Guardian. The company, described as…
topics.text:
trump-linked oil firm plans greenland drilling without government approval
a texas-based company called greenland energy is preparing to spend about $60 million drilling two exploratory wells in remote parts of greenland, according to the guardian. the company, described as linked to donald trump, has not received permission from greenland's government, which has issued a strong warning ahead of the operation. drilling has not yet begun. critics characterise the plan as an attempt to take greenland's natural resources without a military deployment.

topics.headline: Israel said to be preparing unilateral strikes on Iran
topics.snippet: Israeli News Channel 13 reported that Israel has concluded the United States is not willing to go far enough to achieve Israel's objectives against Iran. Israel is therefore preparing to resume strike…
topics.text:
israel said to be preparing unilateral strikes on iran
israeli news channel 13 reported that israel has concluded the united states is not willing to go far enough to achieve israel's objectives against iran. israel is therefore preparing to resume strikes on iran unilaterally and to the extent it sees fit. iran has separately said it is not reopening its strait or reversing its moves anytime soon.

topics.headline: Pentagon gives contractors 21 days to boost weapons output as Iran war drains stockpiles
topics.snippet: The Pentagon has given defense contractors 21 days to identify ways to rapidly increase weapons production as the war with Iran depletes US stockpiles. The US has reportedly expended more than 850 Tom…
topics.text:
pentagon gives contractors 21 days to boost weapons output as iran war drains stockpiles
the pentagon has given defense contractors 21 days to identify ways to rapidly increase weapons production as the war with iran depletes us stockpiles. the us has reportedly expended more than 850 tomahawks, roughly 1,000 patriot and thaad interceptors and 1,300 tactical ballistic missiles. industry is being asked to accelerate deliveries, expand production and add new manufacturing capacity.

topics.headline: Attorney General Todd Blanche appears in the Epstein files he oversaw redacting
topics.snippet: Documents in the Epstein files include Todd Blanche, now Attorney General and previously Donald Trump's personal criminal defense attorney. Emails show Blanche discussing Epstein's criminal case aroun…
topics.text:
attorney general todd blanche appears in the epstein files he oversaw redacting
documents in the epstein files include todd blanche, now attorney general and previously donald trump's personal criminal defense attorney. emails show blanche discussing epstein's criminal case around the time of epstein's 2019 arrest, when blanche was in private practice at the law firm cadwalader. the names of those he corresponded with are redacted, and the redactions do not involve victim or survivor information. blanche oversaw those redactions while serving as deputy attorney general.

topics.headline: Massie says starting a Middle East war is the administration's costliest blunder
topics.snippet: Representative Thomas Massie wrote that of the administration's actions — including withholding Epstein files, attempting tariffs without Congress, advocating more spending, ignoring DOGE and indemnif…
topics.text:
massie says starting a middle east war is the administration's costliest blunder
representative thomas massie wrote that of the administration's actions — including withholding epstein files, attempting tariffs without congress, advocating more spending, ignoring doge and indemnifying glyphosate — starting a war in the middle east will prove the biggest and most costly. the post came as us munitions stockpiles are being drawn down by the conflict with iran.

topics.headline: Flock camera error leads police to hold innocent Wisconsin driver at gunpoint
topics.snippet: Brookfield police stopped a car on I-94 in Waukesha County, Wisconsin, with weapons drawn after a Flock automated license plate reader flagged the vehicle as connected to an active Milwaukee homicide…
topics.text:
flock camera error leads police to hold innocent wisconsin driver at gunpoint
brookfield police stopped a car on i-94 in waukesha county, wisconsin, with weapons drawn after a flock automated license plate reader flagged the vehicle as connected to an active milwaukee homicide investigation. police say it was both the wrong car and the wrong people; when brookfield contacted milwaukee, milwaukee said it no longer needed the vehicle or occupants and the driver was released. milwaukee police chief jeffrey norman has defended the flock system as a tool to remove violent offenders from the street. the dane county board had voted to pull funding for flock contracts over trust concerns before later restoring it.

topics.headline: Democrats prepare wide-ranging investigations of Trump and linked companies
topics.snippet: Democrats in Congress are preparing extensive investigations targeting Donald Trump, his family, his businesses and companies tied to his administration, including BlackRock, Palantir and Tesla. Contr…
topics.text:
democrats prepare wide-ranging investigations of trump and linked companies
democrats in congress are preparing extensive investigations targeting donald trump, his family, his businesses and companies tied to his administration, including blackrock, palantir and tesla. control of either the house or the senate in january would give them the gavel and subpoena power. targets named include the trump revocable trust, which holds his business and real estate assets, along with donors to the ballroom project and other initiatives.

topics.headline: New Orleans to route 911 calls through AI answering agents
topics.snippet: The Orleans Parish Communications District, the emergency dispatch agency for New Orleans, is integrating AI answering agents into its workflow, according to the Shreveport Times. The tool, described…
topics.text:
new orleans to route 911 calls through ai answering agents
the orleans parish communications district, the emergency dispatch agency for new orleans, is integrating ai answering agents into its workflow, according to the shreveport times. the tool, described as ai emergency call triage, is meant to prioritise calls, escalate higher-priority emergencies to human dispatchers and automatically handle repeat calls about ongoing incidents. experts have raised concerns about callers who cannot verbally communicate their situation, such as someone being abducted.

topics.headline: Man publicly plans to release 1,000 pigs in Dearborn's Muslim community
topics.snippet: Videos posted by a man identifying himself as Steve in Alabama describe a plan to transport around 1,000 pigs to Dearborn, Michigan, and stage an accident releasing them, targeting the city's large Mu…
topics.text:
man publicly plans to release 1,000 pigs in dearborn's muslim community
videos posted by a man identifying himself as steve in alabama describe a plan to transport around 1,000 pigs to dearborn, michigan, and stage an accident releasing them, targeting the city's large muslim population. a follow-up video says the group is concealing its location after being stopped twice while collecting additional loads. michigan's ethnic intimidation law, mcl 750.147b, enhances penalties for crimes motivated by religion or national origin, and such an act could also implicate federal hate crime and religious freedom statutes as well as conspiracy charges.

topics.headline: Cassidy backs Blanche confirmation while acknowledging criticism
topics.snippet: Senator Bill Cassidy said he would vote for Todd Blanche's confirmation, stating that he expected to be criticised for the vote. The vote is being scrutinised alongside Blanche's confirmation as Attor…
topics.text:
cassidy backs blanche confirmation while acknowledging criticism
senator bill cassidy said he would vote for todd blanche's confirmation, stating that he expected to be criticised for the vote. the vote is being scrutinised alongside blanche's confirmation as attorney general.

topics.headline: Trump posts through the night on Truth Social amid Iran standoff
topics.snippet: Donald Trump posted extensively on Truth Social over a 24-hour period, including a rendering of a proposed drone port on the White House roof above his planned ballroom featuring service members, dron…
topics.text:
trump posts through the night on truth social amid iran standoff
donald trump posted extensively on truth social over a 24-hour period, including a rendering of a proposed drone port on the white house roof above his planned ballroom featuring service members, drones and vehicles. he also attacked abdul el-sayed, the michigan democratic senate nominee, and his wife, and touted 40 club championships won at his own clubs. the posting came as iran said it would not reverse its recent moves anytime soon.

topics.headline: New Lincoln Memorial signs blame prior administrations for drained reflecting pool
topics.snippet: Signage installed at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool states the pool has been partially refilled so contractors can flush the piping system for the first time in more than a decade. The text attr…
topics.text:
new lincoln memorial signs blame prior administrations for drained reflecting pool
signage installed at the lincoln memorial reflecting pool states the pool has been partially refilled so contractors can flush the piping system for the first time in more than a decade. the text attributes the condition to years of neglect by prior administrations, saying more than half of the 58 water supply ports were so clogged they were deemed non-functioning. the pool is currently half filled, and cameras have been installed across the national mall to deter people from entering it.

topics.headline: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general in 50-49 overnight vote
topics.snippet: The Senate confirmed acting Attorney General Todd Blanche as permanent Attorney General in a 50-49 vote taken around 4:30 a.m., after Louisiana Senator Bill Cassidy dropped his hold and said he would…
topics.text:
senate confirms todd blanche as attorney general in 50-49 overnight vote
the senate confirmed acting attorney general todd blanche as permanent attorney general in a 50-49 vote taken around 4:30 a.m., after louisiana senator bill cassidy dropped his hold and said he would vote yes. all democrats opposed the nomination, and republicans susan collins of maine and a senator from alaska did not support him. blanche, previously trump's personal lawyer, has disputed the premise that the justice department is withholding information about men who abused jeffrey epstein's victims, telling a reporter that the question assumed a hidden trove of information he had never claimed existed. critics say millions of files remain unreleased.

topics.headline: Congress leaves for recess without passing SAVE Act, funds government to December 11
topics.snippet: Republicans left Washington for the August recess without passing the SAVE Act, which is now considered dead. Before leaving, Congress passed a bill keeping the government open through December 11. Tr…
topics.text:
congress leaves for recess without passing save act, funds government to december 11
republicans left washington for the august recess without passing the save act, which is now considered dead. before leaving, congress passed a bill keeping the government open through december 11. trump had urged lawmakers to stay in washington and skip the recess; members are expected to be away until at least mid-september.

topics.headline: Trump moves again to fire Fed governor Lisa Cook
topics.snippet: Trump is preparing another attempt to remove Lisa Cook from the Federal Reserve Board of Governors. The Supreme Court declined to permit her removal during an earlier attempt.
topics.text:
trump moves again to fire fed governor lisa cook
trump is preparing another attempt to remove lisa cook from the federal reserve board of governors. the supreme court declined to permit her removal during an earlier attempt.

topics.headline: Trump signs two new executive orders limiting birthright citizenship
topics.snippet: Trump signed two additional executive orders seeking to restrict birthright citizenship in the United States. The orders are widely expected to face constitutional challenges.
topics.text:
trump signs two new executive orders limiting birthright citizenship
trump signed two additional executive orders seeking to restrict birthright citizenship in the united states. the orders are widely expected to face constitutional challenges.

topics.headline: ICE to equip agents with body cameras but limit footage release
topics.snippet: ICE said its agents will be fitted with body cameras, but that footage will only be released when doing so is in what the agency called the best interests of the agency. The policy was announced headi…
topics.text:
ice to equip agents with body cameras but limit footage release
ice said its agents will be fitted with body cameras, but that footage will only be released when doing so is in what the agency called the best interests of the agency. the policy was announced heading into november.

topics.headline: Wisconsin police used Flock camera network to justify marijuana search
topics.snippet: According to 404 Media, police in Wisconsin used a Flock automated licence plate camera to track a man driving to Michigan, where marijuana is legal, and back into Wisconsin, where it is not. Officers…
topics.text:
wisconsin police used flock camera network to justify marijuana search
according to 404 media, police in wisconsin used a flock automated licence plate camera to track a man driving to michigan, where marijuana is legal, and back into wisconsin, where it is not. officers then cited his interstate travel as probable cause to search his vehicle, found marijuana and arrested him. the case raises questions about using camera-network travel data as a pretext for vehicle searches.

topics.headline: Iran moves to bar US and Israeli ships from the Strait of Hormuz
topics.snippet: NPR reported that Iran is aiming to ban United States and Israeli vessels from transiting the Strait of Hormuz, while other countries would be permitted. The move would affect oil movement and broader…
topics.text:
iran moves to bar us and israeli ships from the strait of hormuz
npr reported that iran is aiming to ban united states and israeli vessels from transiting the strait of hormuz, while other countries would be permitted. the move would affect oil movement and broader trade flows through the waterway, coming amid ongoing us tariff and trade disputes.

topics.headline: Israeli speaker calls for public pressure to halt the war
topics.snippet: An Israeli speaker described daily pain over conditions in Gaza, citing thousands of Palestinian civilians killed, repeated displacement, and the loss of hospitals and schools. He also cited Israeli h…
topics.text:
israeli speaker calls for public pressure to halt the war
an israeli speaker described daily pain over conditions in gaza, citing thousands of palestinian civilians killed, repeated displacement, and the loss of hospitals and schools. he also cited israeli hostages held for two years in inhumane conditions and palestinian political prisoners in israeli jails. he urged israelis, jews and palestinians to take whatever action they can while governments hesitate.

topics.headline: French lawyer for Palestinian ICC victims says Mossad hacking attempt exposed Israeli data
topics.snippet: A French lawyer, one of roughly a dozen worldwide representing Palestinian victims at the International Criminal Court, said Israeli intelligence attempted to hack his phone and in the process left it…
topics.text:
french lawyer for palestinian icc victims says mossad hacking attempt exposed israeli data
a french lawyer, one of roughly a dozen worldwide representing palestinian victims at the international criminal court, said israeli intelligence attempted to hack his phone and in the process left its own data on the device. he publicised the attempt online. no major news organisation has reported the claim.

topics.headline: Lebanon and Israel agree on shortlist of countries to verify Hezbollah disarmament
topics.snippet: Lebanon and Israel have agreed on a shortlist of countries that would verify Hezbollah's disarmament under a US-brokered deal. The countries on the shortlist have not yet been named.
topics.text:
lebanon and israel agree on shortlist of countries to verify hezbollah disarmament
lebanon and israel have agreed on a shortlist of countries that would verify hezbollah's disarmament under a us-brokered deal. the countries on the shortlist have not yet been named.

topics.headline: Bus driver may have prevented explosive drone attack at German airport
topics.snippet: German prosecutors say a drone found at an airport carried professional explosives and a detonator. A bus driver's actions may have stopped the attack from being carried out.
topics.text:
bus driver may have prevented explosive drone attack at german airport
german prosecutors say a drone found at an airport carried professional explosives and a detonator. a bus driver's actions may have stopped the attack from being carried out.

topics.headline: Patriot interceptor stockpiles running low as global demand rises
topics.snippet: Supplies of Patriot missile interceptors are falling worldwide as demand surges across multiple theatres, including Ukraine and the Middle East. Production is not keeping pace with the rate of use.
topics.text:
patriot interceptor stockpiles running low as global demand rises
supplies of patriot missile interceptors are falling worldwide as demand surges across multiple theatres, including ukraine and the middle east. production is not keeping pace with the rate of use.

topics.headline: Treasury raises third-quarter borrowing estimate to $739 billion
topics.snippet: In an August 3 statement, the Treasury Department said it expects to borrow $739 billion in privately held net marketable debt during the July-September 2026 quarter, $68 billion more than it projecte…
topics.text:
treasury raises third-quarter borrowing estimate to $739 billion
in an august 3 statement, the treasury department said it expects to borrow $739 billion in privately held net marketable debt during the july-september 2026 quarter, $68 billion more than it projected in may, citing lower expected cash flow. it also projects a further $628 billion in borrowing in the fourth quarter, totalling roughly $1.36 trillion over six months. the debt would be sold to individuals, banks, pension funds, and foreign governments and investors.

topics.headline: US intervenes in Japan's currency market to support the yen
topics.snippet: The United States has intervened in Japan's currency market, buying yen to prop up the currency. Japan is the largest foreign holder of US Treasury debt, and a Japanese sell-off would flood the market…
topics.text:
us intervenes in japan's currency market to support the yen
the united states has intervened in japan's currency market, buying yen to prop up the currency. japan is the largest foreign holder of us treasury debt, and a japanese sell-off would flood the market with us debt and reduce demand for new issuance at a time when interest costs on roughly $40 trillion in debt are at record highs. the intervention is characterised as a short-term measure that could be followed by federal reserve easing and higher inflation.

topics.headline: Worst job numbers since 2020 released as voters cite rising costs
topics.snippet: Job figures released Friday were among the worst since 2020, alongside continued increases in consumer prices including gasoline. Trump voters interviewed said they regret their votes, with some sayin…
topics.text:
worst job numbers since 2020 released as voters cite rising costs
job figures released friday were among the worst since 2020, alongside continued increases in consumer prices including gasoline. trump voters interviewed said they regret their votes, with some saying they no longer plan to vote. trump has attributed likely republican losses in the coming election to congressional republicans rather than to himself.

topics.headline: Puerto Rico begins rationing water amid severe drought
topics.snippet: Puerto Rico has started rationing water as a once-in-a-generation drought depletes supplies. The governor announced rolling 48-hour windows during which some communities, including areas of San Juan,…
topics.text:
puerto rico begins rationing water amid severe drought
puerto rico has started rationing water as a once-in-a-generation drought depletes supplies. the governor announced rolling 48-hour windows during which some communities, including areas of san juan, will be without water. the measures come at the peak of summer, and there are calls for fema and the federal government to surge resources to the island.

topics.headline: Protections for 23 million acres of Arctic public land contested in court
topics.snippet: The National Petroleum Reserve-Alaska covers about 23 million acres, roughly the size of Indiana, and is the largest single block of intact public land in the United States. At its centre is Teshekpuk…
topics.text:
protections for 23 million acres of arctic public land contested in court
the national petroleum reserve-alaska covers about 23 million acres, roughly the size of indiana, and is the largest single block of intact public land in the united states. at its centre is teshekpuk lake, 3.65 million acres of wetlands supporting caribou, brown bears, beluga whales and molting grounds for hundreds of thousands of migratory birds, with multiple iñupiat communities relying on the land for most of their food. protections for the area have been granted, cancelled and reinstated more than once this year through litigation. the arctic is warming three to four times faster than the rest of the planet.

topics.headline: Nancy Mace says every Muslim officeholder is a threat to national security
topics.snippet: Republican Representative Nancy Mace wrote that every Muslim holding public office in America is a trojan horse and a threat to both national security and the republic. The post drew hundreds of thous…
topics.text:
nancy mace says every muslim officeholder is a threat to national security
republican representative nancy mace wrote that every muslim holding public office in america is a trojan horse and a threat to both national security and the republic. the post drew hundreds of thousands of views. critics compared the rhetoric to the wave of islamophobia that followed the september 11 attacks and called for it to be publicly challenged.

topics.headline: Reporter challenges Trump over claim he is among the greatest presidents
topics.snippet: Asked whether Democrats would pursue oversight and impeachment if they retake the House, Trump replied that a lot of people are saying he is one of the greatest presidents ever, and the reporter respo…
topics.text:
reporter challenges trump over claim he is among the greatest presidents
asked whether democrats would pursue oversight and impeachment if they retake the house, trump replied that a lot of people are saying he is one of the greatest presidents ever, and the reporter responded that they are not saying that. house democrats are already preparing investigations into trump, his family, his businesses and their associates, including through subpoenas.

topics.headline: Mississippi police investigate death of woman found hanging from tree
topics.snippet: Tasia Fortune, a 29-year-old Black woman, was found hanging from a tree behind an abandoned home in Mississippi in the past week, according to the Mississippi Free Press. The Jackson Police Department…
topics.text:
mississippi police investigate death of woman found hanging from tree
tasia fortune, a 29-year-old black woman, was found hanging from a tree behind an abandoned home in mississippi in the past week, according to the mississippi free press. the jackson police department has opened an investigation to determine her cause of death, and her body was sent to the state medical examiner for an autopsy. few other facts have been released publicly, and local authorities are urging federal officials to assist. it is at least the second such case reported in mississippi in the past year.

topics.headline: Hunter Biden says Joe Biden's prostate cancer has metastasized
topics.snippet: Speaking to the BBC, Hunter Biden said his father's prostate cancer has metastasized into his bones and beyond, describing it as very painful and debilitating. He said the situation is very sad to wat…
topics.text:
hunter biden says joe biden's prostate cancer has metastasized
speaking to the bbc, hunter biden said his father's prostate cancer has metastasized into his bones and beyond, describing it as very painful and debilitating. he said the situation is very sad to watch and that he wishes his father would complain more. joe biden has maintained a limited public schedule and has a book due out after the midterm election.

topics.headline: US economy lost 23,000 jobs in July as forecasts missed by 100,000
topics.snippet: The July employment report showed a net loss of 23,000 jobs, against economist expectations of a gain of 85,000. June's figure was revised down by a further 37,000, while the unemployment rate fell to…
topics.text:
us economy lost 23,000 jobs in july as forecasts missed by 100,000
the july employment report showed a net loss of 23,000 jobs, against economist expectations of a gain of 85,000. june's figure was revised down by a further 37,000, while the unemployment rate fell to 4.1%. economists described the report as one of the worst monthly readings since 2020, with commentary attributing part of the weakness to automation of roles through ai.

topics.headline: Blanche confirmation vote narrows to a single Republican senator
topics.snippet: Senator Lisa Murkowski of Alaska said she will not vote to confirm Todd Blanche as Attorney General, following Susan Collins's announcement of the same position, leaving the nomination at the maximum…
topics.text:
blanche confirmation vote narrows to a single republican senator
senator lisa murkowski of alaska said she will not vote to confirm todd blanche as attorney general, following susan collins's announcement of the same position, leaving the nomination at the maximum number of republican defections it can absorb. attention turned to senator bill cassidy of louisiana, whom trump had endorsed against. cassidy was later reported to be prepared to vote yes, which would allow trump's former personal attorney to be confirmed.

topics.headline: Judge orders Blanche and DOJ into court over Epstein file redactions
topics.snippet: Federal judge Emmet Sullivan ordered Todd Blanche and the Justice Department to appear and explain why they are not complying with a court order in the Katie Phang lawsuit, including their failure to…
topics.text:
judge orders blanche and doj into court over epstein file redactions
federal judge emmet sullivan ordered todd blanche and the justice department to appear and explain why they are not complying with a court order in the katie phang lawsuit, including their failure to provide documentation supporting redactions and a privilege log. separately, the new mexico department of justice sued blanche and the federal department, alleging it is withholding epstein files from the only ongoing criminal investigation in the country.

topics.headline: Saudi Arabia says coordinated attacks from Iraq and Yemen may be imminent
topics.snippet: A senior Saudi official told Reuters the kingdom expects imminent attacks on two fronts, from Iraqi militias to the north and Yemen's Houthis to the south, alongside Iran's IRGC. The official said Sau…
topics.text:
saudi arabia says coordinated attacks from iraq and yemen may be imminent
a senior saudi official told reuters the kingdom expects imminent attacks on two fronts, from iraqi militias to the north and yemen's houthis to the south, alongside iran's irgc. the official said saudi arabia anticipates strikes on civilian infrastructure and civilian casualties. the assessment is based on intelligence reports.

topics.headline: Iran threatens Gulf infrastructure and weighs Strait of Hormuz shipping ban
topics.snippet: Sources said Iran warned Gulf states it would strike their infrastructure if new US strikes hit Iranian territory, and urged those states to restrain the Trump administration. Separately, Iran's legis…
topics.text:
iran threatens gulf infrastructure and weighs strait of hormuz shipping ban
sources said iran warned gulf states it would strike their infrastructure if new us strikes hit iranian territory, and urged those states to restrain the trump administration. separately, iran's legislature is reviewing a bill to bar us and israeli vessels from the strait of hormuz. oil prices rose by more than $3 on the shipping proposal.

topics.headline: Analysis says Trump has no clear exit from the Iran war
topics.snippet: An analysis of the conflict concluded that Trump faces few viable paths out of the war with Iran as diplomatic efforts and mutual threats intensify. The Strait of Hormuz features as a central pressure…
topics.text:
analysis says trump has no clear exit from the iran war
an analysis of the conflict concluded that trump faces few viable paths out of the war with iran as diplomatic efforts and mutual threats intensify. the strait of hormuz features as a central pressure point in the standoff.

topics.headline: US munitions stockpiles depleted as Patriot supplies run short worldwide
topics.snippet: The Washington Post reported that US defense stockpiles have been drawn down to a degree that will take years and billions of dollars to replenish. Patriot interceptor stocks in particular are falling…
topics.text:
us munitions stockpiles depleted as patriot supplies run short worldwide
the washington post reported that us defense stockpiles have been drawn down to a degree that will take years and billions of dollars to replenish. patriot interceptor stocks in particular are falling as global demand rises across ukraine and the middle east. reporting also indicated defense secretary pete hegseth had told trump the weapons situation was less dire than it was.

topics.headline: Appeals court blocks White House ballroom construction
topics.snippet: The DC Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that construction of a new White House ballroom cannot proceed without explicit approval from Congress, affirming a lower court injunction. The court said Congres…
topics.text:
appeals court blocks white house ballroom construction
the dc circuit court of appeals ruled that construction of a new white house ballroom cannot proceed without explicit approval from congress, affirming a lower court injunction. the court said congress has not given the executive branch authority to dramatically redesign, reshape and reconstruct the white house. the ruling is stayed for 14 days to allow an appeal to the supreme court; a separate underground military facility was not blocked.

topics.headline: Exposed Flock camera interfaces revealed unencrypted public surveillance feeds
topics.snippet: A researcher said dozens, later nearly 70, Flock Safety camera administration interfaces were reachable through a commercial search engine with no username, password or encryption, exposing live and 3…
topics.text:
exposed flock camera interfaces revealed unencrypted public surveillance feeds
a researcher said dozens, later nearly 70, flock safety camera administration interfaces were reachable through a commercial search engine with no username, password or encryption, exposing live and 31 days of archived footage, and shared the findings with 404 media. the exposed devices included flock's new condor pan-tilt-zoom cameras, which use ai to detect and follow people, and one camera pointed at a playground. the footage could be cross-referenced with commercial facial recognition and public records to identify individuals, and the interfaces allowed deletion of stored evidence. flock's chief executive has separately defended pervasive monitoring by comparing deterrence to parental oversight of children.

topics.headline: All eight Flock cameras stolen from Minnesota town
topics.snippet: In Winona, Minnesota, an unidentified thief cut down the poles holding all eight of the town's Flock surveillance cameras. Each costs about $3,000 to repair, and local law enforcement has lost the tra…
topics.text:
all eight flock cameras stolen from minnesota town
in winona, minnesota, an unidentified thief cut down the poles holding all eight of the town's flock surveillance cameras. each costs about $3,000 to repair, and local law enforcement has lost the tracking capability while the town faces the replacement bill. there are more than 100,000 flock cameras nationwide, and their use by police, including to track a woman who had an abortion, has drawn criticism.

topics.headline: Trump voter turns against president after ICE detains his fiancée
topics.snippet: John Gannon, a 75-year-old businessman and lifelong Republican who voted for Trump in 2024, said he would not do so again after his 45-year-old fiancée, Venezuelan immigrant Yasmin Suarez Regis, was d…
topics.text:
trump voter turns against president after ice detains his fiancée
john gannon, a 75-year-old businessman and lifelong republican who voted for trump in 2024, said he would not do so again after his 45-year-old fiancée, venezuelan immigrant yasmin suarez regis, was detained by ice at george bush intercontinental airport in houston in late july. gannon said eight ice agents surrounded her and took her away without explanation. he said enforcement is picking up law-abiding people and destroying families and jobs.

topics.headline: White House official account uses Spider-Man imagery to promote deportations
topics.snippet: The official White House social media account posted a Spider-Man image that resolves into the message that criminal aliens will be caught and deported, timed to the release of a new Spider-Man film.…
topics.text:
white house official account uses spider-man imagery to promote deportations
the official white house social media account posted a spider-man image that resolves into the message that criminal aliens will be caught and deported, timed to the release of a new spider-man film. the account is the channel foreign governments and world leaders use for information about the united states. it follows a series of similar enforcement messages from the account since trump took office.

topics.headline: Trump described as withdrawing as Republicans brace for midterm losses
topics.snippet: Advisers told Axios and other outlets that Trump is detached and retreating following weak economic data, and no longer believes he would be to blame if Republicans lose the House or Senate, saying vo…
topics.text:
trump described as withdrawing as republicans brace for midterm losses
advisers told axios and other outlets that trump is detached and retreating following weak economic data, and no longer believes he would be to blame if republicans lose the house or senate, saying voters like him but not the party. republicans on capitol hill are urging him to focus on affordability. he is instead said to be focused on construction projects at the white house, including a triumphal arch, ballroom and helipad.

topics.headline: Judge stays financial discovery in Trump's $10 billion BBC suit
topics.snippet: A federal judge stayed the BBC's financial discovery requests in the $10 billion defamation suit Trump brought against the broadcaster. The BBC had sought Trump's and the Trump Organization's financia…
topics.text:
judge stays financial discovery in trump's $10 billion bbc suit
a federal judge stayed the bbc's financial discovery requests in the $10 billion defamation suit trump brought against the broadcaster. the bbc had sought trump's and the trump organization's financial records as part of its defense. trump argued he would amend his complaint to drop damages tied to his financial interests, making the discovery moot, and the judge agreed to pause it.

topics.headline: Uganda clears path to send troops to Gaza under Trump plan
topics.snippet: Uganda's parliament cleared the way for a troop deployment to Gaza as part of a multinational security force envisaged under Trump's plan for the territory.
topics.text:
uganda clears path to send troops to gaza under trump plan
uganda's parliament cleared the way for a troop deployment to gaza as part of a multinational security force envisaged under trump's plan for the territory.

topics.headline: Regional states condemn Gaza strikes as Israel blames Hamas
topics.snippet: States in the region condemned a new round of strikes in Gaza. Israel attributed the strikes to Hamas violations of the ceasefire.
topics.text:
regional states condemn gaza strikes as israel blames hamas
states in the region condemned a new round of strikes in gaza. israel attributed the strikes to hamas violations of the ceasefire.
