topics.headline: Largest US public land block faces expanded oil leasing
topics.snippet: The National Petroleum Reserve-Alaska, 23 million acres on Alaska's North Slope, is the largest single block of public land in the United States and has no permanent roads or trails. Set aside in 1923…
topics.text:
largest us public land block faces expanded oil leasing
the national petroleum reserve-alaska, 23 million acres on alaska's north slope, is the largest single block of public land in the united states and has no permanent roads or trails. set aside in 1923 as a navy oil supply, it was transferred to the interior department in 1976 with instructions to allow exploration while protecting fish, wildlife and subsistence users, leaving which areas are protected to the discretion of each administration. about 82% of the reserve was open to oil leasing last year, and in march the government held the largest lease sale in the reserve's history.

topics.headline: Campaign presses for protection of Bears Ears National Monument
topics.snippet: Utah Diné Bikéyah is renewing a public campaign to protect Bears Ears National Monument, gathering supporter stories and donations. A tribal leader described an obligation passed down from ancestors n…
topics.text:
campaign presses for protection of bears ears national monument
utah diné bikéyah is renewing a public campaign to protect bears ears national monument, gathering supporter stories and donations. a tribal leader described an obligation passed down from ancestors never to forget the landscape their community lived on, stretching to the la sal mountains. the area's plants are used as medicine and its wildlife has long supported the community.

topics.headline: Military recruiting surge tied to a weak job market
topics.snippet: The Army has already met this fiscal year's recruiting target after struggling in recent years, with more than 61,500 people signing on for active duty. Historically, recruiting improves during recess…
topics.text:
military recruiting surge tied to a weak job market
the army has already met this fiscal year's recruiting target after struggling in recent years, with more than 61,500 people signing on for active duty. historically, recruiting improves during recessions, wage stagnation and high youth unemployment, a pattern documented since the start of the all-volunteer force and reinforced by deindustrialization. the modern war institute noted in 2024 that economic growth tends to hamper recruitment, raising the question of how far the defense system depends on limited civilian opportunity.

topics.headline: McConnell discharged from rehabilitation to recover at home
topics.snippet: Mitch McConnell said he was discharged from a rehabilitation center to continue recovery at home, thanking doctors, nurses and therapists as well as colleagues and Kentuckians for their support. He sa…
topics.text:
mcconnell discharged from rehabilitation to recover at home
mitch mcconnell said he was discharged from a rehabilitation center to continue recovery at home, thanking doctors, nurses and therapists as well as colleagues and kentuckians for their support. he said he will maintain an intensive physical therapy regimen from home during the state work period and continue engaging with staff and colleagues on senate business. no photograph or video was released. with the senate's august session ending, he is not expected back before mid-september at the earliest, and his term ends in january.

topics.headline: Trump says U.S. held all-day talks with Iran as Tehran denies negotiations
topics.snippet: President Trump said negotiations involving Iran were "moving along very nicely" and that more could be known within 48 hours, describing all-day talks with Tehran. Qatar reported progress by mediator…
topics.text:
trump says u.s. held all-day talks with iran as tehran denies negotiations
president trump said negotiations involving iran were "moving along very nicely" and that more could be known within 48 hours, describing all-day talks with tehran. qatar reported progress by mediators, but iranian officials denied that direct talks were already underway. trump also linked the diplomatic movement to recent record highs in the stock market.

topics.headline: Trump post on munitions stocks follows Camp David clash with Hegseth over shortage
topics.snippet: In a late-night post, Trump said the United States has massive amounts of munitions, that large quantities are being manufactured, and that "leakers of these treasonous statements" would be hunted dow…
topics.text:
trump post on munitions stocks follows camp david clash with hegseth over shortage
in a late-night post, trump said the united states has massive amounts of munitions, that large quantities are being manufactured, and that "leakers of these treasonous statements" would be hunted down and face long-term jail sentences. the post responded to reporting that u.s. weapons stocks have been drawn down by the war in iran. according to two people who spoke to the washington post, trump pressed defense secretary pete hegseth at a camp david meeting last friday over reports that hegseth had left him with the impression the shortage was already resolved, and hegseth blamed his deputy stephen feinberg for the shortfall and for failing to keep trump informed.

topics.headline: Iran warns Gulf states it will strike energy infrastructure if U.S. attacks again
topics.snippet: Five sources told Reuters that Iran has threatened Gulf energy sites and infrastructure in the event of new U.S. strikes on Iranian territory. Tehran also urged Gulf allies to restrain Trump from orde…
topics.text:
iran warns gulf states it will strike energy infrastructure if u.s. attacks again
five sources told reuters that iran has threatened gulf energy sites and infrastructure in the event of new u.s. strikes on iranian territory. tehran also urged gulf allies to restrain trump from ordering further attacks.

topics.headline: New Mexico sues Justice Department over access to Epstein records
topics.snippet: The New Mexico Department of Justice filed a lawsuit against the Trump Justice Department, accusing it of stonewalling access to documents tied to the state's criminal investigation into Jeffrey Epste…
topics.text:
new mexico sues justice department over access to epstein records
the new mexico department of justice filed a lawsuit against the trump justice department, accusing it of stonewalling access to documents tied to the state's criminal investigation into jeffrey epstein's conduct at the zorro ranch. the state attorney general says the investigation is the only active criminal probe into epstein's crimes and that federal officials have withheld records despite repeated promises to cooperate with state and local law enforcement. a similar suit previously secured the release of unredacted documents in the epstein probe.

topics.headline: FCC repeals cap limiting broadcast station ownership reach
topics.snippet: The Federal Communications Commission scrapped a 22-year-old rule barring any single broadcast company from owning stations reaching more than 39% of U.S. households. Ownership reach will now be asses…
topics.text:
fcc repeals cap limiting broadcast station ownership reach
the federal communications commission scrapped a 22-year-old rule barring any single broadcast company from owning stations reaching more than 39% of u.s. households. ownership reach will now be assessed case by case, clearing the way for corporate consolidation of local broadcast stations to begin almost immediately.

topics.headline: Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt of Congress
topics.snippet: Republicans on a Senate committee voted 8-5 to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after Democrats failed in an attempt to table the vote. Rand Paul and other Republicans on the committee s…
topics.text:
senate committee votes to hold fauci in contempt of congress
republicans on a senate committee voted 8-5 to hold dr. anthony fauci in contempt of congress after democrats failed in an attempt to table the vote. rand paul and other republicans on the committee said fauci had refused to answer their questions. the committee could theoretically send a criminal referral to the justice department, though it is unclear whether prosecutors would act on it.

topics.headline: ICE officer describes Palantir targeting app and loyalty monitoring inside the agency
topics.snippet: In an anonymous interview, an ICE enforcement officer said the agency uses ELITE, a Palantir-built targeting system developed with DHS that comes preinstalled on agency phones, with a mobile version f…
topics.text:
ice officer describes palantir targeting app and loyalty monitoring inside the agency
in an anonymous interview, an ice enforcement officer said the agency uses elite, a palantir-built targeting system developed with dhs that comes preinstalled on agency phones, with a mobile version for license plate checks and a desktop version for in-depth analysis of potential targets. the officer said the mobile app was tested during operation metro surge and warned that over-reliance on ai can produce bad arrests and improper checks. the officer also criticised a mandatory white house app on work phones as propaganda, described growing surveillance of federal employees' loyalty to the president, and compared recent government and pentagon firings to purges.

topics.headline: Deportation push has cost taxpayers an average of $2,358 each
topics.snippet: According to the Economic Policy Institute, American taxpayers have paid an average of $2,358 each to fund the administration's mass deportation effort, with residents of higher-tax jurisdictions such…
topics.text:
deportation push has cost taxpayers an average of $2,358 each
according to the economic policy institute, american taxpayers have paid an average of $2,358 each to fund the administration's mass deportation effort, with residents of higher-tax jurisdictions such as washington, d.c. paying roughly $3,900. the same sum could instead have covered snap benefits for hundreds of thousands of people, public housing assistance for tens of thousands, or medicaid for 30,000. no tariff refunds or stimulus payments are expected.

topics.headline: Trump files emergency motion to block BBC from obtaining financial records
topics.snippet: Trump filed an emergency motion asking a court to stay a prior order requiring him to turn over financial records linked to the January 6th insurrection to the BBC. The order arose from discovery in T…
topics.text:
trump files emergency motion to block bbc from obtaining financial records
trump filed an emergency motion asking a court to stay a prior order requiring him to turn over financial records linked to the january 6th insurrection to the bbc. the order arose from discovery in trump's own $10 billion lawsuit against the broadcaster, with the first production deadline set for the following day. motions asking a judge to reconsider or stay an existing order are difficult to win.

topics.headline: Marine One came within 0.8 miles of passenger jet after air traffic control lapse
topics.snippet: New York Times reporting says the military helicopter carrying Trump came within 0.8 miles laterally and 700 feet vertically of an Envoy Air flight, a breach of the FAA's safe separation standard of 1…
topics.text:
marine one came within 0.8 miles of passenger jet after air traffic control lapse
new york times reporting says the military helicopter carrying trump came within 0.8 miles laterally and 700 feet vertically of an envoy air flight, a breach of the faa's safe separation standard of 1.5 miles laterally or 500 feet vertically. the marine one crew attempted to warn controllers in the national airport tower before takeoff but the communications were not heard, putting the helicopter in the jet's path. the white house said the president was at no point in harm's way and that it retains full confidence in the marine one staff.

topics.headline: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate primary despite heavy AIPAC spending
topics.snippet: Abdul El-Sayed won the Democratic Senate primary in Michigan after more than $40 million in AIPAC-linked spending failed to defeat him. Supporters framed the result, alongside Thomas Massie's earlier…
topics.text:
abdul el-sayed wins michigan senate primary despite heavy aipac spending
abdul el-sayed won the democratic senate primary in michigan after more than $40 million in aipac-linked spending failed to defeat him. supporters framed the result, alongside thomas massie's earlier primary win, as a rejection of lobbying money in congressional races. el-sayed now faces a general election contest in november.

a study of u.s. special operations personnel found brain aneurysms were about three times more common in the group with higher exposure to repeated blasts. the finding links occupational blast exposure to vascular injury in the brain.

save our bacon act stripped from senate farm bill as republicans push to restore it
the senate agriculture committee will consider its version of the farm bill, from which republican senator john boozman removed the save our bacon act. senator joni ernst is pushing behind the scenes to reinstate the provision, and agricultural industry groups are lobbying democratic senators including amy klobuchar to support its return. the measure, introduced last year by representative ashley hinson, would bar states from regulating animal welfare and could roll back existing state laws.

topics.text:
former openai forecaster warns of catastrophic ai risk and autonomous agent behaviour
a former openai researcher who worked on forecasting said the industry's open secret is the possibility of creating a new species that ends up ruling the world, putting roughly a 70% chance on outcomes as severe as human extinction. he said he resigned and forfeited around $2 million by refusing to sign a non-disparagement clause, and that he has shortened his timelines to 2027 and 2028 because rival ceos are racing each other for control of the most powerful systems. an interviewee also described an ai agent that autonomously purchased and shipped a robot dog and requested permission to program it, and claimed agents have traded large sums among themselves.

crowd at trump event boos mention of deceased police officer's name
at a trump event in nevada, the state's governor mentioned officer abdel nabi, a police officer who recently died. members of the crowd booed on hearing the name, prompting the governor to interject that the officer had passed away and that no one should be booing him.

topics.snippet: Responding to Senator Ed Markey, a veteran lawmaker said Markey had voted to send them to the Iraq war and should not lecture them on the definition of a war crime. They said they have repeatedly call…
topics.text:
veteran lawmaker rebukes markey over iraq war vote in war crimes exchange
responding to senator ed markey, a veteran lawmaker said markey had voted to send them to the iraq war and should not lecture them on the definition of a war crime. they said they have repeatedly called out netanyahu's conduct in gaza and elsewhere, as well as war crimes by russia and the united states, naming pete hegseth. they also noted markey had been unable to admit his iraq war vote was a mistake and had confused iran with vietnam while discussing a $1 trillion war budget.

topics.headline: Attorney General Todd Blanche recorded pledging permanent nationwide abortion restrictions

topics.text:
attorney general todd blanche recorded pledging permanent nationwide abortion restrictions
audio from a late-july private white house faith office call with prayer leaders captures attorney general todd blanche saying the administration is working with hhs, the fda and the white house to make the dobbs decision "permanent in every single state." blanche said policies are being put in place so that other states and organizations cannot challenge state-level protections for the unborn, and specifically cited mail-order abortion drugs. he said the effort has taken 19 months without "complete victory" but predicted victory would be soon and permanent, and asked the prayer leaders to build support in their congregations.

topics.text:
trump says u.s. held all-day talks with iran as tehran denies negotiations
trump said the united states conducted "all-day" talks with iran, a claim tehran denied. the statement follows a long series of similar public assertions from trump that a deal with iran is close, that iran wants an agreement more than the u.s. does, and that the war would end quickly.

topics.headline: Families say crew of USS Abraham Lincoln face mold, shortages and worn flight deck
topics.snippet: Families of service members aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, deployed in connection with the war in Iran, described moldy showers, ongoing food shortages and crew running out of toothpaste, deodorant a…
topics.text:
families say crew of uss abraham lincoln face mold, shortages and worn flight deck
families of service members aboard the uss abraham lincoln, deployed in connection with the war in iran, described moldy showers, ongoing food shortages and crew running out of toothpaste, deodorant and soap. they said sailors work excruciatingly long shifts and rarely get days off, raising concerns that falling morale and fatigue could lead to mistakes. one father, a navy veteran, said his son described holes worn through the carrier's flight deck.

topics.headline: Wired reports military GPS jammer test preceded fatal New Mexico medevac crash
topics.snippet: New reporting from Wired links a fatal civilian medevac crash in New Mexico to the U.S. military's testing of an experimental GPS jammer, conducted around the time the FAA shut down air traffic to El…
topics.text:
wired reports military gps jammer test preceded fatal new mexico medevac crash
new reporting from wired links a fatal civilian medevac crash in new mexico to the u.s. military's testing of an experimental gps jammer, conducted around the time the faa shut down air traffic to el paso's airport earlier this year. the twin-engine medevac jet, carrying two pilots and two medical workers, departed roswell and struck the side of a mountain. the account attributes the crash to a combination of gps jamming from a nearby missile range, low visibility and air traffic control stretched beyond capacity, leaving the crew unaware of terrain between the aircraft and the landing site. everyone on board was killed.

topics.text:
russian missile strikes kill at least 17 near kyiv as air defences intercept none of 24 missiles
russian missile strikes killed at least 17 people and damaged logistics sites around kyiv, officials said. ukraine's air force said none of 24 incoming ballistic missiles were intercepted, which was attributed to a shortage of air defences.

topics.headline: Republican-backed ballot measures defeated in Missouri and Kansas
topics.snippet: Voters rejected three Republican-backed ballot initiatives in red states. Missouri's Amendment 4, which would have required citizen initiatives to win majorities in all eight congressional districts,…
topics.text:
republican-backed ballot measures defeated in missouri and kansas
voters rejected three republican-backed ballot initiatives in red states. missouri's amendment 4, which would have required citizen initiatives to win majorities in all eight congressional districts, failed, as did amendment 5, a plan to phase out the state income tax and raise sales taxes. in kansas, voters rejected a measure to change how state supreme court justices are selected, an outcome described as leaving the current court composition in place until at least 2041. in other results, cori bush lost her bid to return to congress against incumbent wesley bell in missouri.

topics.snippet: The Heritage Foundation has merged with the Election Transparency Initiative, a group that advocates routine mass purging of voter rolls in all 50 states. States administer elections and maintain vote…
topics.text:
heritage foundation merger raises concerns over continuous voter roll purges
the heritage foundation has merged with the election transparency initiative, a group that advocates routine mass purging of voter rolls in all 50 states. states administer elections and maintain voter rolls, and august 5, 2026 was set as the date such mass purges must stop; the initiative wants them to continue, including close to the midterm elections, which could leave eligible voters wrongly removed from the rolls. roughly 70% of those working in trump's cabinet were said to have ties to the heritage foundation.

a republican senator, john cornyn, said there is nothing congress can do to rein in the president, describing anti-weaponization funding he had backed as dead and saying that was all that could be done under the circumstances. cornyn subsequently voted to confirm todd blanche as attorney general.

topics.text:
entry-level job openings down 73% over four years
according to forbes, the number of entry-level jobs in the united states has fallen 73% over the past four years. inexperienced candidates are welcomed in one of every 50 job openings, down from one in 15 in 2022, and there are 27% fewer salaried openings. scarcity has also increased the number of applicants per opening, making interviews harder to obtain for new college and master's graduates.

reported $46.5 million operation aims to shape what ai systems say about israel
a $46.5 million operation is said to be planting hundreds of pro-israel articles across websites built largely by chatbots, with the goal of changing how ai systems including chatgpt, copilot and grok describe israel and middle east geopolitics. brad parscale, a former trump campaign manager with ties to the salem media group, was named as involved in the effort. the concern raised is that users treat ai output as objective, making such content a vector for large-scale misinformation.

trump posted praise for alan dershowitz, who served as jeffrey epstein's lawyer and who wrote a late-1990s los angeles times op-ed arguing the age of consent should be lowered to 15. separately, senator ron wyden discussed an interview and investigation into epstein on cbs that is said to involve multiple governments, large banking systems and high-profile individuals. the claim raised is that legacy media outlets, cbs among them, have not covered and are suppressing that investigation.

topics.text:
trump-endorsed candidate loses michigan primary to opponent who had withdrawn
in michigan's eighth congressional district republican primary, thomas smith — who dropped out last month, raised no money and had told voters not to back him — won the nomination. trump's endorsed candidate, amir hassan, finished roughly 11,000 votes and about 17 points behind. the seat is considered a toss-up that republicans had hoped to win, and smith may need to re-enter the race.

topics.text:
u.s. has expended nearly all long-range precision missiles in iran war
reuters reported that the u.s. army has used "virtually all" of its stockpile of army tactical missile systems and precision strike missiles in the five months since the iran war began, according to people familiar with the data. about half of the navy's tomahawk cruise missile inventory has also been expended, and patriot interceptor stocks are reported down more than 65% between february and july. the munitions are considered critical to any potential conflict with china, and production is not keeping pace with expenditure, raising readiness concerns.

topics.headline: Senate report says major banks ignored Epstein's suspicious transactions for decades
topics.snippet: A report released by Senator Ron Wyden concludes that JPMorgan Chase, Deutsche Bank and Bank of America systematically failed to report Jeffrey Epstein's suspicious transactions for nearly two decades…
topics.text:
senate report says major banks ignored epstein's suspicious transactions for decades
a report released by senator ron wyden concludes that jpmorgan chase, deutsche bank and bank of america systematically failed to report jeffrey epstein's suspicious transactions for nearly two decades despite knowing he was a convicted sex offender with trafficking ties. the report calls for a federal criminal investigation into the banks, names multiple executives, and seeks criminal probes into epstein associates darren indyke, richard kahn and harry beller. treasury secretary scott bessent has declined repeated senate requests for treasury's epstein-related files, though the same records were provided to the republican-led house oversight committee. a "60 minutes" segment taped with wyden about the report has not aired, and the reporter who taped it was subsequently fired.

topics.headline: Supreme Court judgment on birthright citizenship becomes final
topics.snippet: The Supreme Court has issued its formal judgment in the birthright citizenship case, making the June 30 order upholding birthright citizenship final. The administration said it would seek a rehearing…
topics.text:
supreme court judgment on birthright citizenship becomes final
the supreme court has issued its formal judgment in the birthright citizenship case, making the june 30 order upholding birthright citizenship final. the administration said it would seek a rehearing but missed the roughly 25-day deadline to do so. the clerk published the judgment after that window closed, leaving no further avenue for reconsideration in the case.

topics.headline: Justice Department order shields Trump and his company from IRS back taxes
topics.snippet: An order issued by Deputy Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche reaffirms that Donald Trump, Eric Trump, Donald Trump Jr. and the Trump Organization will not be required to pay back taxes owed to the…
topics.text:
justice department order shields trump and his company from irs back taxes
an order issued by deputy attorney general nominee todd blanche reaffirms that donald trump, eric trump, donald trump jr. and the trump organization will not be required to pay back taxes owed to the irs. the order is reported to be part of a deal struck with republican senators to secure blanche's confirmation, alongside his rescission of a $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization" fund. two republican holdouts have since said they will back the confirmation.

topics.headline: U.S. attorney drops more reflecting pool charges as Trump weighs firing her
topics.snippet: U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro has dropped criminal charges against three more people accused of damaging or interfering with the reflecting pool in Washington, after earlier…
topics.text:
u.s. attorney drops more reflecting pool charges as trump weighs firing her
u.s. attorney for the district of columbia jeanine pirro has dropped criminal charges against three more people accused of damaging or interfering with the reflecting pool in washington, after earlier dropping charges against olympian david hearn. in court filings, her office stated the pool's deterioration was caused by a rushed and substandard contracting job rather than vandalism, and described the president's account as untrue. trump said pirro "folded like an umbrella" and choked, and has indicated she may be removed from the post.

topics.headline: Administration plans sweeping rollback of Head Start requirements
topics.snippet: The administration is preparing a major overhaul of Head Start, the federal program providing free preschool to low-income families, according to the Associated Press. More than 100 pages of federal r…
topics.text:
administration plans sweeping rollback of head start requirements
the administration is preparing a major overhaul of head start, the federal program providing free preschool to low-income families, according to the associated press. more than 100 pages of federal requirements covering child-to-teacher ratios, health screenings and other standards would be cut to a few dozen pages, with the rest left to states. the rule is expected this week and could take effect over the coming months.

topics.headline: Central Command solicits "unconventional" ideas to pressure Iran
topics.snippet: An officer in U.S. Central Command's intelligence branch sent a message to a broad group of military analysts asking for "new creative and unconventional ways to pressure and punish Iran," according t…
topics.text:
central command solicits "unconventional" ideas to pressure iran
an officer in u.s. central command's intelligence branch sent a message to a broad group of military analysts asking for "new creative and unconventional ways to pressure and punish iran," according to a source familiar with the message. a second source said a senior officer had circulated a similar solicitation the previous week. the request has been read as a sign that planners lack a settled strategy for the conflict.

topics.headline: Qatar reports progress toward U.S.-Iran talks as Tehran denies negotiations
topics.snippet: Qatar said mediators are making progress toward talks between the United States and Iran. Tehran denied that any negotiations have begun.
topics.text:
qatar reports progress toward u.s.-iran talks as tehran denies negotiations
qatar said mediators are making progress toward talks between the united states and iran. tehran denied that any negotiations have begun.

topics.headline: Deaths reported in Spain's Ceuta enclave after mass border crossing
topics.snippet: Spanish authorities said more than 70 people died during an unprecedented surge of crossings into the North African enclave of Ceuta that began on Thursday, with some drowning and others crushed while…
topics.text:
deaths reported in spain's ceuta enclave after mass border crossing
spanish authorities said more than 70 people died during an unprecedented surge of crossings into the north african enclave of ceuta that began on thursday, with some drowning and others crushed while attempting to climb a breakwater and border fence. officials reported that tens of thousands crossed by land and sea at one of the european union's only two land borders with africa, and that more than 48,000 returned to morocco within the first 48 hours. migrants leaving the enclave described a lack of food, sleep and medical care, and 862 unaccompanied minors were being processed under special legal protections. the episode has heightened tensions between spain, morocco and the eu over border policy.

topics.headline: Reuters review finds 75 First Amendment rulings against the administration
topics.snippet: A Reuters review of lower-court cases identified 75 rulings against the administration on First Amendment grounds. The tally is set against the president's pledge to "bring free speech back."
topics.text:
reuters review finds 75 first amendment rulings against the administration
a reuters review of lower-court cases identified 75 rulings against the administration on first amendment grounds. the tally is set against the president's pledge to "bring free speech back."

topics.headline: Pentagon signs $3 billion deal to expand Patriot and THAAD interceptor output
topics.snippet: The United States signed an agreement worth more than $3 billion with Lockheed Martin to expand production of interceptor components. The Pentagon said the deal would allow Patriot output to triple an…
topics.text:
pentagon signs $3 billion deal to expand patriot and thaad interceptor output
the united states signed an agreement worth more than $3 billion with lockheed martin to expand production of interceptor components. the pentagon said the deal would allow patriot output to triple and thaad output to quadruple.

topics.headline: Trump promotes Gaza plan as strikes intensify
topics.snippet: Residents of Gaza said the administration's disarmament proposal is at odds with worsening conditions on the ground. The plan was being promoted publicly while strikes intensified.
topics.text:
trump promotes gaza plan as strikes intensify
residents of gaza said the administration's disarmament proposal is at odds with worsening conditions on the ground. the plan was being promoted publicly while strikes intensified.

topics.headline: Denmark begins 11-month conscription and includes women for first time
topics.snippet: Denmark has begun an extended 11-month period of military service, up from four months, with an initial intake of 1,600 recruits. Women are included in conscription for the first time. The expansion c…
topics.text:
denmark begins 11-month conscription and includes women for first time
denmark has begun an extended 11-month period of military service, up from four months, with an initial intake of 1,600 recruits. women are included in conscription for the first time. the expansion comes amid the war in ukraine and rising arctic tensions, including u.s. demands regarding greenland.

topics.headline: Ukrainian drones strike three Russian warehouses
topics.snippet: Ukrainian drones hit three warehouses across Russia, according to officials. Five people were killed at a separate warehouse in the Moscow region.
topics.text:
ukrainian drones strike three russian warehouses
ukrainian drones hit three warehouses across russia, according to officials. five people were killed at a separate warehouse in the moscow region.

topics.headline: Michigan reports first deaths in national cyclospora outbreak
topics.snippet: The Michigan Department of Health announced two deaths from cyclosporiasis, the first fatalities linked to the ongoing national outbreak of the cyclospora parasite. Michigan alone has confirmed more t…
topics.text:
michigan reports first deaths in national cyclospora outbreak
the michigan department of health announced two deaths from cyclosporiasis, the first fatalities linked to the ongoing national outbreak of the cyclospora parasite. michigan alone has confirmed more than 11,000 foodborne illness cases and 193 hospitalizations, with cases reported in 45 states. officials noted that death from the infection is uncommon but can result from severe dehydration.

topics.headline: Tribes and activists press for national park status after Bears Ears rollback
topics.snippet: Speakers at an Indigenous-led rally in Utah called for permanent protection of Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante, arguing both should become national parks. Organizers said five sovereign natio…
topics.text:
tribes and activists press for national park status after bears ears rollback
speakers at an indigenous-led rally in utah called for permanent protection of bears ears and grand staircase-escalante, arguing both should become national parks. organizers said five sovereign nations had won a seat at the table in managing bears ears before the president reduced the monument, after which tribal seals were removed from signage. the proclamation on bears ears was described as characterizing petroglyphs and pictographs as too common to protect while reserving acreage around a 1926 oil well, and the grand staircase order names 15 minerals, including uranium, copper and cobalt, for extraction. speakers also disputed the president's claim that hunting, fishing and walking are effectively barred on the monuments.

topics.headline: AIPAC spending shapes Michigan Senate primary as endorsements land
topics.snippet: Ahead of Michigan's August 4 primary, the American Israel Public Affairs Committee is reported to have directed more than $35 million to Haley Stevens, opponent of Abdul El-Sayed, exceeding the more t…
topics.text:
aipac spending shapes michigan senate primary as endorsements land
ahead of michigan's august 4 primary, the american israel public affairs committee is reported to have directed more than $35 million to haley stevens, opponent of abdul el-sayed, exceeding the more than $25 million the group spent to unseat representative thomas massie. el-sayed received an endorsement framed as a rejection of that spending. voters were urged to turn out on primary day.

topics.headline: White House invites Meta and Anthropic to discuss voluntary AI security testing
topics.snippet: Meta and Anthropic were invited to discuss voluntary AI cybersecurity testing with White House officials. The talks concern testing arrangements undertaken on a voluntary basis.
topics.text:
white house invites meta and anthropic to discuss voluntary ai security testing
meta and anthropic were invited to discuss voluntary ai cybersecurity testing with white house officials. the talks concern testing arrangements undertaken on a voluntary basis.

topics.snippet: The administration used federal funds to produce an AI-generated video promoting itself. The production drew criticism online, with commenters comparing its style to state propaganda.
topics.text:

the administration used federal funds to produce an ai-generated video promoting itself. the production drew criticism online, with commenters comparing its style to state propaganda.

topics.headline: US strike in Iranian village killed family, investigation finds
topics.snippet: A New York Times investigative report found that the United States recently dropped a 2,000-pound bomb on a residential village in Iran, killing a husband, his wife and their two-year-old son. Officia…
topics.text:
us strike in iranian village killed family, investigation finds
a new york times investigative report found that the united states recently dropped a 2,000-pound bomb on a residential village in iran, killing a husband, his wife and their two-year-old son. official accounts describe the operation as targeting iranian revolutionary guard elements. images of the site show the remains of the destroyed residential area.

topics.headline: Every stakeholder in the Iran war is dissatisfied with Trump
topics.snippet: Governments across the region and factions in Washington have expressed frustration with the American president's handling of the war in Iran. Saudi Arabia and Qatar are said to be unhappy that peace…
topics.text:
every stakeholder in the iran war is dissatisfied with trump
governments across the region and factions in washington have expressed frustration with the american president's handling of the war in iran. saudi arabia and qatar are said to be unhappy that peace has not materialised, while the united arab emirates, kuwait and bahrain regard him as too dovish. israel is reported to be upset that he called off large-scale strikes on iran, iran is angry over continued threats and reversals, and hawks in the united states are dissatisfied that the conflict has not produced regime change in tehran.

topics.headline: Oil falls more than $4 a barrel as Trump holds off new Iran strike
topics.snippet: Oil prices dropped by more than $4 a barrel after the president declined to order a new attack on Iran while pursuing a nuclear agreement. Talks are reported to be aimed at reopening the Strait of Hor…
topics.text:
oil falls more than $4 a barrel as trump holds off new iran strike
oil prices dropped by more than $4 a barrel after the president declined to order a new attack on iran while pursuing a nuclear agreement. talks are reported to be aimed at reopening the strait of hormuz.

topics.headline: US military emails troops asking for ideas to punish Iran
topics.snippet: According to CNN, an officer in US Central Command's intelligence branch sent an email last week to a broad group of service members and analysts asking for "new creative and unconventional ways to pr…
topics.text:
us military emails troops asking for ideas to punish iran
according to cnn, an officer in us central command's intelligence branch sent an email last week to a broad group of service members and analysts asking for "new creative and unconventional ways to pressure and punish iran." the request came as the administration described negotiations as under way, while iran issued a statement saying it is not in active talks with the united states. the president has repeatedly threatened large-scale strikes on iran and then backed away from them.

topics.headline: Justice Department deal shields Trump and sons from IRS audits ahead of Blanche confirmation
topics.snippet: Todd Blanche signed an amendment late at night terminating the $1.776 billion weaponization fund while preserving an audit agreement that applies retroactively to Donald Trump, Eric Trump, Donald Trum…
topics.text:
justice department deal shields trump and sons from irs audits ahead of blanche confirmation
todd blanche signed an amendment late at night terminating the $1.776 billion weaponization fund while preserving an audit agreement that applies retroactively to donald trump, eric trump, donald trump jr. and the trump organization, barring irs audits for prior years. the deal is understood to have been struck to secure blanche's confirmation as attorney general. questions have been raised about whether the amendment is valid given that the original agreement required signatures from all parties and only blanche signed, and about whether a further amendment could void the terms once senators john cornyn and thom tillis leave office. january 6 defendants could also still obtain federal payouts through other routes, including wrongful death suits and the federal tort claims act.

topics.headline: Congressional candidate confronts Fox News over Epstein files
topics.snippet: Oliver Larkin, a congressional candidate in Florida, used a Fox News appearance to challenge the network's framing of child sexual abuse in the immigration debate, asking whether there is an acceptabl…
topics.text:
congressional candidate confronts fox news over epstein files
oliver larkin, a congressional candidate in florida, used a fox news appearance to challenge the network's framing of child sexual abuse in the immigration debate, asking whether there is an acceptable benchmark for the number of children raped. he called for the president to be held accountable along with others implicated in the epstein files, which he said the department of justice has still not released. he also said pressure has been directed at representative thomas massie for pursuing accountability on the issue.

topics.headline: Police chief used Flock camera network to track ex-partner 600 times
topics.snippet: Marcy Bakley, 50, installed cameras in her home and had her car scanned for tracking devices after suspecting she was being watched. According to the Washington Post, her ex-partner, police chief Mich…
topics.text:
police chief used flock camera network to track ex-partner 600 times
marcy bakley, 50, installed cameras in her home and had her car scanned for tracking devices after suspecting she was being watched. according to the washington post, her ex-partner, police chief michael steffman, ran roughly 600 searches on her and her teenage daughter using flock license plate technology and was later arrested on stalking charges. there are now about 120,000 flock cameras nationwide performing a record 20 billion plate scans a month, and authorities have charged roughly 50 people for misusing the system, many of them men in law enforcement surveilling partners or exes.

topics.headline: Six mass shootings recorded across the US over the weekend
topics.snippet: Data from the Gun Violence Archive records six mass shootings in the United States over the past weekend: Rochester, New York (one killed, five injured); Portland, Oregon (one killed, five injured); H…
topics.text:
six mass shootings recorded across the us over the weekend
data from the gun violence archive records six mass shootings in the united states over the past weekend: rochester, new york (one killed, five injured); portland, oregon (one killed, five injured); huntsville, alabama (one killed, four injured); dunn, north carolina (two killed, two injured); twin falls, idaho, at an in-n-out (three killed, eight injured); and jacksonville, florida (four injured). the archive puts the year's total at 280 mass shootings, more than the number of days elapsed in 2026, with hundreds of children killed and thousands injured or killed by gun violence this year.

topics.headline: Republican senator calls for Max Miller's resignation over abuse allegations
topics.snippet: Representative Max Miller, accused of abusing his ex-wife and of injuring his two-year-old daughter, issued a statement asserting he did nothing wrong, citing his ex-wife's mental health and asking wh…
topics.text:
republican senator calls for max miller's resignation over abuse allegations
representative max miller, accused of abusing his ex-wife and of injuring his two-year-old daughter, issued a statement asserting he did nothing wrong, citing his ex-wife's mental health and asking whether an assault victim would have offered to cook him dinner days later. senator bernie moreno of ohio, the father of miller's ex-wife emily moreno, responded by calling on miller to resign, saying he needs serious psychological help and is a danger to his daughter and granddaughter. miller has refused to resign.

topics.headline: Kentucky governor says August 3 deadline for McConnell special election is meaningless
topics.snippet: Reports had described August 3 as the last date on which Governor Andy Beshear could call a special election for Mitch McConnell's Senate seat before November's general election, but Beshear said the…
topics.text:
kentucky governor says august 3 deadline for mcconnell special election is meaningless
reports had described august 3 as the last date on which governor andy beshear could call a special election for mitch mcconnell's senate seat before november's general election, but beshear said the date carries no significance. he said mcconnell's absence benefits democrats because he cannot vote on todd blanche's confirmation or other pending business. mcconnell's capitol police detail remains outside george washington university hospital; his team says he is at a rehabilitation facility, and his physician's statement said he was discharged from hospital care rather than from the hospital. the senate heads into an august recess and returns in september.

topics.headline: Trump launches paid Truth Social API amid market manipulation concerns
topics.snippet: A service called Truth API launched, offering faster access to the president's Truth Social posts for a reported $100,000 a month. Critics say the posts have been moving markets during the war and tha…
topics.text:
trump launches paid truth social api amid market manipulation concerns
a service called truth api launched, offering faster access to the president's truth social posts for a reported $100,000 a month. critics say the posts have been moving markets during the war and that selling early access amounts to selling market-moving information to paying subscribers. the arrangement has been described as grounds for impeachment and prosecution.

topics.headline: Pirro drops criminal case against Olympian over White House reflecting pool
topics.snippet: Acting US Attorney General Jeanine Pirro dropped the criminal case against an Olympian charged with damaging the newly built reflecting pool at the White House, acknowledging the case was rushed and t…
topics.text:
pirro drops criminal case against olympian over white house reflecting pool
acting us attorney general jeanine pirro dropped the criminal case against an olympian charged with damaging the newly built reflecting pool at the white house, acknowledging the case was rushed and that the conduct was not a chargeable offence. the decision was announced late on a friday. the move has prompted speculation that pirro will be removed, following the departures of pam bondi, kristi noem and tulsi gabbard, each of whom was replaced by a man.

topics.headline: Thousands remain in Ceuta after mass migrant crossing leaves 83 dead

topics.text:
thousands remain in ceuta after mass migrant crossing leaves 83 dead
between 3,000 and 5,000 people remain in the spanish enclave of ceuta following a mass crossing that overwhelmed reception centres. at least 83 people died on both sides of the border during the crossings.

topics.headline: Suspected suicide bombing outside Pakistan police station kills 17
topics.snippet: At least 17 people were killed and 34 wounded in a suspected suicide bombing outside a police station in Pakistan, officials said. The Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan claimed responsibility.
topics.text:
suspected suicide bombing outside pakistan police station kills 17
at least 17 people were killed and 34 wounded in a suspected suicide bombing outside a police station in pakistan, officials said. the tehrik-i-taliban pakistan claimed responsibility.
